newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE gains may be limited to 4,665.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE gains may be limited to 4,665.

text.p: In a slow session on the London stock market on Tuesday, the FTSE 100 index will probably stay flat but any gains may be limited to around 4,665, technical analysts said.

Retail banks and pharmaceuticals which had been hit hard on Monday -- the sectors losing 0.7 and 2.5 percent respectively -- may claw back some of their losses to help set a slightly positive tone to the FTSE, they added.
Yesterday's market action showed the FTSE was not prpared to reliquish all its gains since mid-April just yet as it lingered near 4,650. By 0718 GMT, the index was up 0.6 at 4,645.8.

Paradoxically, the best chances of a swift recovery by the market is if it makes a sharp drop first because then it would have overdone the gloom and once investors realise this they will scramble to buy shares once more.
Its suffering may have stopped for the time being so that a repetition of Monday's 49 point plunge is not likely today, analysts said.

That drop took the index back to the middle of a 50 point wide ascending channel which connects the market's intra-day highs and lows since mid-April and these trendlines suggest support is now at 4,610.
Failure to hold above 4,610 over the next few days may mean the current medium-term bull trend is coming to an end.
Much depends on whether the U.S. authorities decide to raise interest rates and if so, by how much. A decision is expected anytime after 1800 GMT.
